discipline: This freeze is committed BEFORE the V3 run.  The module refuses to run (CANNOT_CHECK, exit 2) unless the live source, generator, module and checker digests equal the pins recorded here, so no post-outcome edit can reach a receipt that cites this design.  NO NOVELTY OR BREAKTHROUGH CLAIM.

v1.outcome: M2B_V1_GATING_DEFECT: exact 5/30, attribution FIRE on 25/30 — proc:quadratic_formula never fired (the three mutually exclusive Δ-case constraints were conjoined, so two of them were always revoked for the query); proc:linear fired on a == b == 0 (no b != 0 constraint); the 5 exact were LINEAR_DEGENERATE

changes_made_after_seeing_v1_outcome: CONSTRAINT rule: constraint atoms carrying a case field disjoin per target; non-case constraints conjoin; the gate lives in the target's label (applicability = preconditions x non-case constraints x sum of case constraints)
two constraint atoms added: con:a_zero (case 'a == 0', constrains proc:linear) and con:b_nonzero (constrains proc:linear)
v2.outcome_as_recorded: M2B_POPULATED_AND_SOLVED_ON_DEV, 30/30 exact against the registered oracle
v2.outcome_as_replayed: lane-guards' independent replay (ORION-V2 #295 comment 6) established that the 30/30 figure was not evidence for the claim it was cited for.  Five defects, each repaired in V3 below.

changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.change: each procedure is a hyperpath of STEP atoms carrying a registered operation name and a SymPy-parsable template; one generic interpreter (interpret_hyperpath) walks the enabled hyperpath; no per-procedure Python exists
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.found: apply_procedure() re-implemented every procedure in kso_m2b_algebra_population_v1.py; ALGEBRA_SOURCE_V1.json only NAMED them and carried an unused 'sympy' string, so corrupting a step in the registered source could not change a root
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.proof_obligation: PLANT a: corrupt step:qf:1 (4*a*c -> 3*a*c) in the registered source => the computed root differs from the clean root (mutation asserted to have landed), the oracle disagrees at COMPOSE, and the root is INVALID under the SymPy EXACT_CHECKER; only the corrupted procedure's roots are INVALID (locality)

changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.change: a case atom's constraint_on is the set of procedures it LICENSES; con:delta_neg does not license proc:factor, so on a Delta<0 instance proc:factor's case disjunction is empty and its label is dead.  Every conditional that decided applicability is deleted; atomize_labels decides WHICH CASE HOLDS and never which procedure applies
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.found: the Delta<0 block on factoring was `if delta < 0 or rational_sqrt is None` in apply_procedure; and the three Delta case atoms constrained proc:quadratic_formula ONLY and were disjoined, so with exactly one case live the disjunction was always live and the case atoms gated nothing
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.proof_obligation: PLANT b: flip one constraint atom's label (con:rational_roots) on a real IRRATIONAL_DISTINCT instance => proc:factor fires and its irrational root is INVALID under the declared domain Q; a second plant flips the case licence on a COMPLEX_PAIR instance => a complex root claimed over Q is INVALID.  NO-ALARM: with correct labels proc:factor fires on no IRRATIONAL_DISTINCT and no COMPLEX_PAIR instance

changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.change: the threshold is registered here and main() returns 1 below it
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.defect: (c) the threshold was not a gate
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.found: main() exited 0 at 26/30, 25/30 and 20/30, printing M2B_DEFECT_ATTRIBUTED as a string
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.proof_obligation: PLANT c: a corruption reaching three instances => exit 1.  NO-ALARM: the clean run exits 0

changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.change: the reject condition is SPLIT: a declined proposal and a family mismatch stay counted re-draws (they are proposal shape); a disagreement raises OracleDisagreement naming the instance and the caller reports CANNOT_CHECK and exits 2
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.defect: (d) an oracle disagreement was silently re-drawn
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.found: generate_split folded a disagreement between the two oracle implementations into the per-family rejection counter and drew another instance
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.proof_obligation: PLANT d: a perturbed second oracle => OracleDisagreement naming the instance, exit 2.  NO-ALARM: the clean split raises nothing

changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.change: REGISTERED_RANGE_V3 defines admissibility over BOTH drawn and derived coefficients (abs <= 1728, denominator <= 64 -- the bound implied by b = -a*(r1+r2), c = a*r1*r2 over the drawn grid); check_registered_range raises the typed OutOfRegisteredRange at the oracle AND at the solver
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.found: no admissibility predicate existed; COEFFICIENT_RANGE was documentation only
changes_made_after_seeing_the_v2_replay.proof_obligation: PLANT e: an out-of-range instance is rejected at both ends, exit 2.  NO-ALARM: every one of the 30 generated instances satisfies the predicate

G1.exit: 0 at or above min_exact; 1 below it
G1.statement: produced roots == oracle roots per instance, compared as exact tower VALUES not strings

G2.statement: fired procedures == the oracle's independently computed applicable procedures

G4.statement: retraction both directions over constraint, definition AND step atoms; the renormalising parent must differ on at least one revocation

G5.statement: no-alarm controls: proc:factor fires on no IRRATIONAL_DISTINCT and no COMPLEX_PAIR instance; zero INVALID and zero CANNOT_CHECK root claims on the clean run

G6.statement: every ROOT_CLAIM is decided by the SymPy EXACT_CHECKER; warrant is VALID under the EXACT_CHECKER certificate and nothing else

instances.note: byte-identical instance set to V2, so V2 and V3 are directly comparable

parameters.status: PRE_STUDY_PLACEHOLDER (KSO_PARAMETER_STUDY_V1) -- not yet traceable to a study row

registered_range.rule: abs(x) <= 1728 and x.denominator <= 64 for every coefficient

terminals.CANNOT_CHECK: design drift, oracle disagreement, or an out-of-range instance; exit 2
terminals.M2B_V3_DEFECT_ATTRIBUTED__<stages>: below threshold or a no-alarm control failed; exit 1
terminals.M2B_V3_SOLVED_FROM_THE_SOURCE_AND_WARRAN: G1 threshold met and every no-alarm control holds

v3.warrant: a ROOT_CLAIM is warranted iff kso_exact_checker_sympy_v1 returns VALID; the producing label channel is INSTRUCTION and is ignored for the verdict
